notes.title: v.1.2.3463 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in the previous patch which made it impossible to get the final hidden achievement. Sorry!!
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the interface could get stuck in between modes and not take user input anymore.
[*] Got rid of duplicate event systems spawning into scenes (no actual impact on the user but would cause log files to fill with junk logs)
[*] Fixed bug introduced in previous patch where text intended to have a nonstandard font would have that font stripped 
[*] Put shaders and related code into their own assembly (no real impact on user but it happened!!)
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.2.3333
notes.notes:
What's new in v.1.2.3333?

I found and fixed even more obscure OpenDyslexic errors. Does anyone read these? Is anyone who plays this even dyslexic? I dedicated these hours of my life to you 😂

[list]
[*] OpenDyslexic is now disabled when Russian text is turned on, but if OpenDyslexic is left enabled and language is set back to English, it is also reenabled automatically. (This was to get around OpenDyslexic not containing Cyrillic glyphs.)
[*] Fixed bug where enabling OpenDyslexic, setting language to Russian, then setting language to English without ever leaving the settings menu would result in settings menu text not changing back to OpenDyslexic until the menu was closed and reopened.
[*] Fixed bug where the Quit/Save & Quit button would lose OpenDyslexic formatting when going from a savable scene to a non-savable one or vice-versa.
[*] Fixed awkward wrapping of "Save & Quit" text when OpenDyslexic enabled.
[*] Fixed prologue character card text getting misaligned when OpenDyslexic is on.
[*] Fixed "Loading..." never swapping to OpenDyslexic.
[*] Stopped intentionally glitchy text from swapping fonts to OpenDyslexic.
[*] Fixed version number losing OpenDyslexic formatting if the remote config data arrived after initialization.
[*] Changed all timers based on time since level load with time since mode change to get around timescale being set to zero on pause (this fixed various obscure UI bugs.)
[*] In the last patch I disabled shadowcasting on the light that shines in the last shot of Varya, but I changed my mind and reenabled it.
[*] Fixed a misaligned subtitle in the Act 3 Extra scene.
[*] Fixed an error with Varya's materials in Act 4.
[/list]

notes.title: v.1.2.3331 Update
notes.notes:
What's new in v.1.2.3331?

[list]
[*] Pressing Escape on title menu no longer quits the game.
[*] It is now indicated in English that the sexy and awesome people listed in the credits are playtesters (this had always been indicated in Russian.)
[*] Fixed bug where if high contrast UI and OpenDyslexic were turned on at the same time, there was visible junk markup in every text object.
[*] When swapping to/from OpenDyslexic in the middle of an act, change now takes effect immediately rather than during the following line.
[*] Menu buttons now have consistent underlay styling when OpenDyslexic is on.
[*] Shadow distance and shadow projection is now dynamically set on a camera-shot basis in Act 4 to best balance performance vs. fancy graphics.
[*] Fixed several UI text objects which would never swap fonts to OpenDyslexic, including the version update prompt, playtesters card in credits, and some buttons.
[*] Updated OpenDyslexic font atlas to contain the proud and noble letter ñ
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/cbdfc2d780ced892e0aaf006adbaff2122d2c8f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/da6118b57190652e79b39b3beb285bd75081e5b6.png[/img][/url]
[i]Mwah[/i]
[*] Loading to the middle of a scene from save now more reliable when returning to a line with split subtitle timing
[*] Fixed visual error where the edge of the in-world canvas at the start of act 1 was visible
[*] Fixed unstable shadow flashing in Act 4
[*] Split up several subtitles throughout the play
[*] Various small animation tweaks and fixes
[*] Fixed mistimed camera cut in the middle of act 3
[*] Fixed grass sometimes not appearing on title menu or appearing after a long delay
[*] Fixed error where if captions were turned on, the internal names of credits cards were visibly displayed.
[*] Fixed error where if "always show speaker's name" was on, Hermes' name would be indicated inline during a visual novel-styled segment in Act 3
[*] Fixed error where during a handful of lines in the middle of Act 3, if "always show speaker's name" was on, Hermes' name was indicated as "Ermolai". 
[/list]
